description: In front of you on the bed are a yellow cup, a gray plastic bin with several clear ice cubes inside, and a purple scoop along the right side. The left hand reaches to the yellow cup, grips it as a left-hand object, lifts it over the gray bin, tilts it downward, and dumps ice into the bin before rotating the cup upright and setting it back down; meanwhile the right hand stays near the purple scoop without picking it up.
